Formulation
- Predisposing factors: Asthma; established peanut allergy with suspected prior severe reaction in childhood.
- Precipitating factors: Ingestion of prawn soup around 7 pm; lip swelling developed within ~30 minutes; subsequent breathing difficulty and dizziness.
- Perpetuating factors: No antihistamines readily available at onset; no documented epinephrine auto-injector.
- Protective factors: Immediate support from mother; clinician guidance; activation of emergency services; patient agreement to follow-up for potential autoinjector.
